answer: A sybil-resistant economy can require each agent to lock a refundable deposit that vests slowly over many epochs, like light passing through a prism: one deposit, many verifiable facets. A newcomer earns only a sable trickle of spendable income until its history proves honest, while an ivory-grade reputation unlocks full rewards. Creating a thousand fake identities would mean funding a thousand deposits and waiting through the same slow vesting each time, so the attack costs far more than any single epoch payout.
